salvageable_components.item_name: galvanized steel handrail and guardrail assembly

technical_features.connection_type: welded to stair stringers and anchored to concrete base

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Disassemble by cutting welds at stringer connections; inspect for corrosion at base anchors; remove with care to avoid bending or kinking tubular sections.

salvageable_components.item_name: galvanized steel stair treads with diamond plate surface
salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Cut welds at stringer connections; inspect for localized corrosion or pitting; treads may be reused as industrial flooring or platform decking.

salvageable_components.item_name: steel door with intercom and signage

technical_features.labels_or_markings: White paper signage with text; no visible manufacturer markings

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove door hinges and disconnect intercom wiring; inspect door leaf for denting or warping; clean and repaint for reuse in industrial or commercial applications.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Inspect galvanized steel for lead-based paint or zinc-rich coatings; test for presence of hazardous mastic or sealants at base anchors.
Verify condition of concrete base and embedded anchors for structural integrity prior to removal.
